features.description: Consumer-family taxonomy + evidence vocabulary. Map the existing 8 qa-sufficiency surface classes into two families (human, agent); add a consumer dimension to the journey model. Add a SINGLE CLOSED evidence_class enum plus a data_provenance marker as NEW optional fields on EvidenceRef WITHOUT inventing new EvidenceRef.type enum values: each evidence_class maps to a valid existing type, and data_provenance is one of seeded|real|degraded. Also add two structured fields to EvidenceRef so degradation/typed-skip and keyed cross-surface comparison are STRUCTURAL not prose: data_source (a stable key) and availability (available|unavailable). A typed-skip is represented as availability=unavailable + data_provenance=degraded — data_provenance is NOT extended with a skip value (D017).
features.acceptance: A pure module defines SurfaceFamily (human, agent) with a total, tested mapping from every one of the 8 existing surface classes to exactly one family. The objective_contract UserJourney gains optional consumer (human|agent|both) and fixture_only (bool); unknown consumer values are rejected. EvidenceRef gains, in the agent-conventions schema + Pydantic model + validator (with a VERSION bump): (a) evidence_class — a SINGLE CLOSED enum defined once and referenced by F002/F003/F004, covering human {screenshot, recording, journey_walk, terminal_transcript, rubric, human_signoff}, agent {tool_call_transcript, cli_transcript, contract_check}, mutation {idempotency, rollback}, structured {structured_error}; (b) data_provenance (seeded|real|degraded); (c) data_source (optional str key); (d) availability (optional, available|unavailable). The EvidenceRef.type enum is NOT extended (test asserts the 8 existing type values are unchanged) and a documented table maps each evidence_class to a valid existing type. Tests cover the total surface->family mapping, consumer validation, the new optional fields parsing, the closed-enum invariant (no evidence_class outside the set is accepted), the typed-skip representation (availability=unavailable + data_provenance=degraded, no new provenance value), and the no-new-type-value invariant.

features.description: Evidence-class typing rule. Pure function from a claim's (surface_class, consumer, claim_kind) to the required evidence_class(es) drawn ONLY from F001's closed enum, plus a checker that matches a claim's evidence by evidence_class AND data_provenance. claim_kind (read_only|mutation|qualitative) is a separate dimension from surface_class because mutation and qualitative are claim kinds, not surfaces, and may share a surface with read-only claims (D014). Seeded evidence does not satisfy a consumer-readiness claim unless the journey is fixture_only. Mismatch is advisory (warn) at implementation time; the close gate (F005) decides blocking.
features.acceptance: required_evidence_classes(surface_class, consumer, claim_kind) is pure and returns classes from F001's closed enum: human read_only/interactive UI -> {screenshot|recording|journey_walk}; cli_human read_only -> {terminal_transcript}; agent mcp_tool/api read_only -> {tool_call_transcript|contract_check, structured_error}; claim_kind=mutation adds {idempotency, rollback} on top of the surface/consumer base; claim_kind=qualitative -> {rubric|human_signoff}. The evidence_class names are EXACTLY F001's enum (contract_check, not contract_test; terminal_transcript for cli_human vs cli_transcript for agent CLI are distinct). A checker, given a claim's (surface_class, consumer, claim_kind) + its evidence (evidence_class + data_provenance), returns satisfied | evidence_class_mismatch (names the missing class) | seeded_masks_readiness (a required class is present but only with data_provenance=seeded while the journey is not fixture_only). Tests: (1) UI read_only claim with only test_output -> evidence_class_mismatch; (2) UI claim with a real screenshot -> satisfied; (3) UI claim satisfied only by a seeded screenshot on a non-fixture_only journey -> seeded_masks_readiness; (4) same on a fixture_only journey -> satisfied; (5) a mutation claim on a UI surface requires idempotency+rollback in addition to the read_only base. The function is pure (no I/O, no input mutation).

features.description: Agent-surface evidence class in the runtime-evidence harness. Three dogfoodable EvidenceSource adapters reusing harness.py Protocol composition and the evidence/goal-governance/post_impl/<source>/<journey>/ convention: (a) CLI non-interactive transcript, (b) MCP tool-call transcript driving DontPanic's own in-process mcp_server (tools/list + a read-only tool), (c) schema/contract-stability check. Each sets an evidence_class drawn from F001's closed agent set + a valid EXISTING EvidenceRef.type + data_provenance, with honest typed-skip represented per D017.
features.acceptance: Three new EvidenceSource adapters register with the harness; each returns list[EvidenceRef] whose type is a valid EXISTING enum value (e.g. log for transcripts, test_output for the contract check, file for artifacts), whose evidence_class is the F001 closed agent vocabulary (tool_call_transcript | cli_transcript | contract_check), and whose data_provenance is set. Artifacts land under evidence/goal-governance/post_impl/<source>/<journey>/. The MCP source invokes the in-process mcp_server (tools/list + one read-only tool e.g. list_projects or status) and records request+response with no secret-shaped field. When a prerequisite is absent, the source emits a typed-skip EvidenceRef represented as availability=unavailable + data_provenance=degraded (NO new provenance value; D017) carrying an operator-readable reason, rather than raising. A harness test runs all three against a fixture journey and asserts artifacts + the source-agnostic invariant (dispatch by registration, never hardcoded source name). No live paid call is made.

features.description: Per-family degraded honesty + structured cross-surface agreement. Add required_data_sources and allowed_degraded_modes (keyed by a shared data-source key, e.g. capability id) to the journey contract. A checker verifies degradation is honest per family and that a typed-skip counts as honest-unavailability evidence rather than journey success, and that human and agent journeys for the same objective agree on capability-availability/provenance compared by the shared key. ALL comparison reads the STRUCTURED EvidenceRef fields introduced in F001 (data_source, availability, data_provenance) — never prose (D012).
features.acceptance: The UserJourney contract accepts required_data_sources[] (each with a stable data_source key) and allowed_degraded_modes[]. Evidence records availability per source structurally on EvidenceRef (F001): an agent capability_unavailable signal IS an agent EvidenceRef with data_source=<key> + availability=unavailable; an honest human label IS a human EvidenceRef with data_source=<key> + availability=unavailable. A pure checker, reading {data_source, availability, data_provenance} off the EvidenceRefs keyed by data_source, reports: (1) degraded_dishonest when a required data_source is absent but no EvidenceRef for that key carries availability=unavailable from either family; (2) that a typed-skip EvidenceRef (availability=unavailable + data_provenance=degraded) for a data_source is treated as honest-unavailability evidence and NEVER as a satisfying consumer-surface capture (test asserts a journey 'covered' only by typed-skips is not satisfied); (3) cross_surface_disagreement when the human and agent EvidenceRefs for the SAME data_source key assert different availability or data_provenance (comparison on the structured fields, not description text). Tests cover honest-degradation pass, degraded_dishonest, typed-skip-not-success, and a keyed UI-promises-available vs API-says-unavailable disagreement. Pure, no I/O.

features.description: Close-time enforcement + disposition. Extend completion_auditor to emit consumer_outcome_unproven and apply the enforcement posture: a pure posture function returns block|advisory by goal_type. At plan close, product-class plans (goal_type in {parity, new_feature, migration, incident}, the objective-contract-required set) with declared consumer journeys BLOCK unless each declared consumer outcome is satisfied (F002), explicitly deferred via a structured non-goal, or operator-dispositioned via a structured record; internal substrate plans (goal_type in {mechanical, infra, refactor}) are advisory unless opted in. consumer=both requires BOTH families proven (D013). Typed-skip and seeded evidence do not count as consumer-surface captures. The >=1-real requirement is about JOURNEY EXECUTION provenance, not data-source availability (D015).
features.acceptance: enforcement_posture(goal_type, opted_in) is pure and returns block for goal_type in {parity, new_feature, migration, incident} and advisory for {mechanical, infra, refactor} unless opted_in. completion_auditor emits consumer_outcome_unproven (added to the gap_class taxonomy with a severity rank) when a contract journey's declared consumer is not proven: for consumer=human or =agent the named family must have a satisfying consumer-surface capture per F002/F004; for consumer=both BOTH families must (a missing family -> consumer_outcome_unproven). substrate-only, seeded-only on a non-fixture_only journey, or typed-skip-only all fail to satisfy. REAL-vs-DEGRADED reconciliation (D015): the required >=1 real (non-seeded) end-to-end journey per objective claim per declared consumer is about the journey EXECUTION running on the real surface (data_provenance != seeded); a required_data_source honestly degraded (availability=unavailable, F004) WITHIN such a real journey still satisfies — only a journey that is entirely seeded / substrate-only / typed-skip-only fails. Deferral is STRUCTURED: an objective_contract non_goal entry that names {journey, consumer}; operator disposition is a STRUCTURED consumer_outcome_dispositions[] record {journey, consumer, reason, dispositioned_by, at} — prose alone never satisfies (D016). At close on a product-class plan, an unsatisfied + non-deferred + non-dispositioned consumer outcome BLOCKS; the same on a substrate plan warns. Tests: (1) product-class human journey with only API-test evidence -> consumer_outcome_unproven AND close blocked; (2) same with a real screenshot capture -> no finding, close not blocked; (3) seeded-only screenshot on a non-fixture_only journey -> blocked; (4) structured operator disposition recorded -> close allowed; (5) substrate plan with the same gap -> warn, not blocked; (6) a journey 'covered' only by typed-skips -> consumer_outcome_unproven; (7) consumer=both with only a human capture -> consumer_outcome_unproven (agent family unproven); (8) a real journey whose required_data_source is honestly degraded -> satisfied, close not blocked.
